text:
Rae: Quick note 1: the model card for `zephyr-mini-embed` still shows 1024 dims in the example JSON. Our inference builds now output 768 for the -embed variant.
Marta: Oof, thanks for catching. That could break our example tests.
Rae: Also the benchmarks link in the catalog points to /bench/zephyr-mini which 404s. I think the new path is /benchmarks/models/zephyr-mini.
Marta: Can you open a docs PR? I'll add a tiny SDK migration snippet and a test.
Rae: Will do. Plan: update example to show 768-length vector, add a compatibility bullet about quantized variants sometimes falling back to CPU on pre-AVX2 hardware, and correct bench link.
Marta: For the compat note can we be specific: "quant-8bit variants may fallback to CPU on AVX2- machines; expect ~2x-4x per-token latency increase and reduced throughput."
InfraSig: Quick comment from infra: CPU fallback behavior varies by BLAS/kernel availability; safe to say 2-4x is a fair range.
Rae: Good. For SDK snippet I propose minimal change to avoid breaking users relying on default selection: ```js
// explicitly pin model to avoid ambiguous defaults
const out = await client.embeddings.create({ model: "zephyr-mini-embed-768", input: ["test"] });
console.log(out.data[0].embedding.length); // -> 768
```
Marta: LGTM. I'll also add a unit test in docs CI that fetches the example response fixture and asserts length === 768.
DocsBot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4281 by Rae (draft). Labels: docs, needs-review.
Rae: Added a short limits clarification: model max_input_tokens=4096; bench throughput run used seq_len=256 per request.
Marta: Nice. Can you also add a redirect note in the archived pages? Some customers hit cached HTML pages with the old bench URL.
Rae: Yep will add a tiny redirect meta and a note in the changelog.
SDK CI: ran example test against staging image, confirmed embedding length 768 and example passes.
InfraSig: Reviewed compat wording, small nit: change "pre-AVX2" to "non-AVX2" to be precise.
Rae: Done in PR. Marking ready for review after a quick CI pass. :rocket:
